_what: EVERY constant of the g-xTB v1.1 method that does NOT live in the official parameter files (gxtb_parameters / basisq / eeq) -- decoded from reference sources or MEASURED from the oracle, one table each, loaded once at start (constants.py). Nothing in the prototype may hardcode a method constant; this file is the single home. Provenance per entry.
_rule: If a value here disagrees with a new measurement, the MEASUREMENT wins and this file gets the update + a provenance note. Values marked 'measured' carry the experiment that produced them.

basis_cn._source: grimme-lab/qvSZP src/chargscfcts.f90 ncoord_basq + app/main.f90 (kn); gate: adapt.py (CN(basis) <= 4e-5 vs oracle on 6 probes incl. PdCl2)

eeqbc._source: multicharge param.f90 new_eeqbc2025_model (arrays byte-identical to param/gxtb/eeq, proven all 103x8 by extract_tables.py); gate: eeqbc.py (q <= 5e-5 vs oracle, 6 probes)
eeqbc.rvdw_unit_quirk: pair vdW radii enter as ANGSTROM literals against Bohr distances (multicharge converts au at declaration, back at use); gate-confirmed the oracle does the same

repulsion._source: SI Sec 1.6 (kexp); structural readings MEASURED by repulsion.py gate (worst 4.75e-9 over 13 cases)
repulsion.alpha_combination: harmonic  (2*aA*aB/(aA+aB); SI Eq. 55 as extracted lost the factor 2 -- refuted 150x by the H2 tail)
repulsion.zeff_charge_signs: Zeff = zeff0*(1 - kq*q - kq2*q^2)  (quadratic MINUS measured by FD ratio -1.000)

reference_occupations._source: SI Tab. 1 (Z<=18, 3 decimals) CONFIRMED by FD on L7 chemical potentials (exact: ES1 linear in mu); convention q_l = refocc - pop; heavier elements get FD-measured and appended here
reference_occupations._note_al: Al d 0.346/0.409 ambiguity in the pdftotext table column split: Mg row carries d 0.346? The SI layout puts d under Mg=0.346? No -- Mg has no d in table; 0.346/0.409/0.287 belong to Al/Si... Al d = 0.409 per column alignment; FD-verify before first use of Na..Ar rows beyond S/Cl (only C,N,O,F,Si,P,S,Cl are FD-verified so far).

oracle_conventions.f_component_order: UNMEASURED -- overlap.py refuses oracle-order f shells by design
oracle_conventions.restart_format: Fortran sequential: rec1 = packed row-lower symmetric density; rec2 = MO matrix column-major (big systems: only occupied columns)
oracle_conventions.coord_format: Turbomole $coord, Bohr; .CHRG/.UHF files; fresh dir per run (stale gxtbrestart crashes)

onsite_electronic_measured._note: charted from the oracle (chart_onsite.py + ion-channel scans); closed forms partly identified. All PROVEN hardcoded in the binary.
onsite_electronic_measured.equal_U_decomposition: ES23(ion; U=u,u) = A + B*u + C*u^2 fits EXACTLY (3-point); B = (s/2)*q_A^2 (even, quadratic to 5 digits); C = k3*q_A^3*u^2-coefficient (cubic to 4 digits); A = u-independent remainder entangled with ion shell redistribution

s_rule._form: s = a_p * Nval + b_p  (linear in valence-electron count WITHIN a period; 9 elements, max dev 2e-4)
s_rule._caveat: d-block/heavy ions (Ge test) show shell-redistribution contamination -- extraction needs population tracking there

third_order_u2_rule._form: the u^2 coefficient = k3 * q_A^3 (exact for C and O across +-1, +-2)
third_order_u2_rule._caveat: row-2 C..O linear (+0.0073/Z) but F breaks it -- F/heavier extractions need the per-state check; refine next

third_order_shape._form: E3_onsite = c1_el * q_A * sum_ll' q_l q_l' (U_l+U_l')^2/4  (the Eq.132 DEGREE-2 kernel applied onsite -- NOT the harmonic the garbled SI line suggested; explains the u^2 rule)
third_order_shape._evidence: chart_onsite2.py: per-point populations + s-rule subtracted; c1 consistent across +- states (F: 0.01628/0.01627; C-1 captures 99.4% of a 0.17 Eh signal at 1e-3)
third_order_shape._resolved: v1's 'F k3 anomaly' dissolved -- F was right; the row-2 linear k3 trend was the artifact of the wrong (u^2-only) shape
third_order_shape._open: C+1 and O+2 carry unmodeled structure (shell-resolved quartic candidate); c1's element rule not yet identified; d-block extraction needs population tracking
